scope: Bounded CPU FP32 development fixtures, not universal model tolerances
rationale: Source ResNet18 FP32 versus FP64 eval max error was 1.893e-7. Forward absolute budget is about 16 times that observed floor, with scale-dependent relative allowance. Gradient/state budgets are predeclared engineering bounds for short FP32 reductions and require first-divergence investigation rather than automatic relaxation. RNN budgets are tighter because fixtures have short sequences and bounded initialized weights. Any changed budget requires a separate source-only calibration and versioned rationale.
